verdict.rationale: Riskified's docs state it provides official SDKs for several languages to simplify API integration, with direct HTTP as an alternative (riskified-docs-5, riskified-docs-25). A mobile SDK integration guide for Android Beacon device-data collection also exists (riskified-docs-27). Missing for 10: the specific languages covered, SDK installation and usage detail or reference docs, evidence of SDK maintenance or versioning, and independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK quality.
